hook: Pet hair owners: here's what the $299 robot mop actually misses

scenes.visual_prompt: Dog shedding visibly on a rug next to a hard floor transition strip, robot vacuum approaching in the background
scenes.on_screen_text: If you have pets, read this first
scenes.voiceover: Before you buy a $299 robot mop for your pet hair problem, here's what reviewers actually report.

scenes.visual_prompt: Macro close-up of a robot vacuum's roller brush with hair visibly tangled around it
scenes.voiceover: The recurring complaint isn't suction power — it's the roller brush tangling with long hair.

scenes.visual_prompt: Robot vacuum mop pad dragging a visible clump of pet hair across a carpet-to-hardwood transition strip
scenes.on_screen_text: Mop pads drag hair at transitions
scenes.voiceover: On carpet transition strips, the mop pads can drag hair into corners instead of picking it up.

scenes.visual_prompt: Short-haired cat walking confidently across a clean hard floor the robot just finished
scenes.voiceover: Short pet hair on hard floors? These robots handle it well.

scenes.visual_prompt: Long-haired dog lounging on an area rug, owner kneeling nearby with a hand tool cleaning the rug edge
scenes.voiceover: Long-haired dogs and cats on area rugs — that's where owners report the most manual cleanup afterward.

scenes.visual_prompt: Hand using a $5.99 6-pack scrub sponge on a baseboard near a litter box, before/after wipe visible
scenes.voiceover: A six-pack of scrub sponges for $5.99 covers the baseboards and litter box perimeters the robot's edge brush misses.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of clean living room, robot docked, owner petting dog on clean floor
scenes.on_screen_text: Full pet-owner breakdown on the blog
scenes.voiceover: Full breakdown of what pet owners should budget for is linked in my bio.

caption: Pet hair is one of the top reasons people search this category right now, so I pulled what reviewers with pets actually report — not the marketing copy. Short answer: short hair on hard floors is fine, long hair on rugs still needs your hands. What closes that gap for $5.99 is in the full post, linked in bio.
